hero_quote: Ultra cycling events that offer the opportunity to explore world-famous places right here in Latvia.
faq_contact_prompt: Didn't find the answer to your question?
faq_a1: Pasaules Ture is a series of ultra cycling events in Latvia that offers the opportunity to explore world-famous places right here in Latvia.
faq_q2: Do I need a special bicycle?
faq_a2: A Gravel or MTB type bicycle is recommended.
faq_a3: Registration takes place online by clicking the 'Register' button on the event page. After payment is received, you will receive a confirmation email.
faq_a4: Yes, each distance has a set time limit. You can find precise information about the time limit in the event facts bar.
faq_q5: What happens if I don't make the time limit?
faq_a5: If you don't make the time limit, you can continue the route and will be counted among the finishers. However, you'll need to organize the finish badge separately after the event.
faq_q6: Are there support points along the route?
faq_a6: Yes, support points with water and snacks are placed along the route. Precise information will be sent to participants before the event.
